lessons.title: Las hermanitas vocales
lessons.objectives: Listens to simple story based on pictorial representation. Follows verbal directions. Pantomimes physical actions according to the story.Produces words with same beginnig sounds. Associates beginning word sounds with vowel symbols “a”, “e”, “i”, “o”, “u”. Asks and answers questions to demonstrate comprehension of simple stories.Recognizes and identifies by name the vowels “a”, “e”, “i”, “o”, “u”.Uses simple vocabulary and short phrases in Spanish.
lessons.vocabulary: Rhyme: "Cinco hermanitas" | Syllables: a, e, i, o, u
lessons.procedures: El maestro invitará a los estudiantes a observar la ilustración. Luego, participarán en actividades orales, identificarán los sonidos, y leerán el vocabulario. Finalmente, completarán los ejercicios de escritura y lenguaje en su libro de actividades.

lessons.title: Oo
lessons.objectives: Listens to nursery rhymes or poems read by the teacher and responds with appropriate sounds, words, and motion. Follows verbal directions. Describes pictures in oral sentences.Rhymes word patterns in poems. Matches same initial word sounds with written word symbols. Recognizes and names upper and lower case alphabet letters.Models and draws lines demonstrating the concept of “top to bottom” and “left to right”. Models and forms lower and upper case letters of the alphabet. Copies simple words.Uses simple vocabulary and short phrases in Spanish.
lessons.procedures: El maestro invitará a los estudiantes a observar la ilustración y contestar: ¿Es la niña gordita o flaquita? ¿Por qué es gordita la niña? Luego, participarán en actividades orales, identificarán los sonidos, y leerán el vocabulario. Finalmente, completarán los ejercicios de escritura y lenguaje en su libro de actividades.
